title: Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs
abstract: arXiv:2610.23707v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its

translated_title: 面向多步骤智能体的工具推荐：找到任务所需的每一个工具
translated_abstract: 当多步骤智能体任务所需的某一个工具缺失时，任务就会失败，然而智能体可能需要的工具数量庞大、难以尽数列出：在我们所研究的平台上，约8,200个工具的定义加起来超过了我们所评估的任何模型的上下文窗口。我们提出了“工具推荐”，这是一个已部署的系统，通过一个由三个工具组成的固定接口，为智能体提供所有这些工具，其数量是典型MCP服务器所暴露工具的数百倍。该系统运行在智能体与工具之间的网关处，以最终用户自己的凭证执行每一次调用，并根据用户对每项服务的授权同意以及智能体可使用的工具范围对其进行核查。我们在公开的检索基准和按计费统计的端到端会话成本上对其进行了评估。在ToolRet上，“工具推荐”将查询所需的每一个工具排进前十名的频率比BM25高出57%（BM25是商业工具搜索所采用的词法排序方法），并且与规模最大达其九倍的已发表系统相比也表现更优。
tldr: 提出了一种已部署的“工具推荐”网关系统，通过固定的三个工具接口让智能体能够访问约8,200个工具（是典型MCP服务器暴露数量的数百倍），并在ToolRet基准上将查询所需工具排进前十的成功率比BM25提高57%。
en_tdlr: Tool Recommendation is a deployed gateway system that gives agents access to thousands of tools through a fixed three-tool interface, placing every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25 on ToolRet.
